question: What dates does Alibaba's FY2026 cover, and why must it not be interpreted as the calendar year ending 31 December 2026?
final_answer: Alibaba Group Holding Limited (HKEX: 09988, 阿里巴巴-W) closes its fiscal year on 31 March: both its East Money company profile and security profile give 年结日 = '03-31'. Its FY2026 therefore covers the twelve months from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026, and the 'FISCAL YEAR 2026 ANNUAL REPORT' was published on HKEXnews on 2026-06-18. It must not be interpreted as the calendar year ending 31 December 2026, because 'FY2026' is a fiscal-year label tied to a March year-end rather than the Gregorian year: the period opens in April 2025 and ends nine months before 31 December 2026. Reading it as a December year-end would shift every balance-sheet date and income-statement period, misalign FY2026 revenue and profit with calendar-year comparisons, and misplace the disclosure timeline (results published June 2026 for a period ended March 2026).
